d: The Mini-Bus Driver is responsible for safely operating company light vehicles and mini-buses to provide transportation for employees and support various operational requirements of the business. The role requires compliance with all company driving, safety, and maintenance procedures while ensuring passengers are transported safely and efficiently.
q: Minimum 2 years of professional driving experience
Good knowledge of Bahrain road networks and traffic regulations
Experience driving mini-buses or staff transportation vehicles is preferred
Ability to communicate effectively and follow instructions
Good driving record and strong commitment to safety
Vehicle inspection and basic maintenance knowledge
r: Operate company mini-buses and light vehicles safely and responsibly
Transport employees to and from work sites, accommodation, offices, and other designated locations as required
Carry out company errands and transport-related tasks as directed by supervisors
Conduct daily vehicle inspections and ensure the vehicle is maintained in accordance with company and manufacturer procedures
Check vehicle condition before operation, including fuel, tires, lights, brakes, battery, and fluid levels
Report any vehicle defects, accidents, or maintenance requirements immediately
Ensure vehicles are kept clean, presentable, and in good working condition at all times
Follow instructions issued by senior staff and the person responsible for transport activities
Maintain accurate records relating to vehicle usage, inspections, and fuel consumption when required
Ensure compliance with all traffic laws and company transport policies
Understand and comply with the Company's Health & Safety Policy, emergency procedures, risk assessments, and safe systems of work
Ensure all transport activities are conducted in compliance with site safety requirements
Wear PPE as required by site safety regulations
Ensure passengers and visitors comply with company safety requirements where applicable
Report all incidents, injuries, vehicle accidents, near misses, and property damage to the Production Foreman and Safety Officer
Attend toolbox talks, safety briefings, and training sessions as required
Drive defensively and safely at all times while observing all traffic legislation and site speed limits
